name: Belagavi
registryBasis: Belagavi City Corporation’s application-procedure page requires a CTS extract and map for a trade-licence application, and references a Form III property-tax register extract for building licensing. The Belagavi District Administration separately identifies a Land Records office at the DC Office and links Karnataka’s RTC service. This is city-local survey/record-service evidence; it does not establish an anonymous vector service or a public full-polygon schema.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
